note: Accounts the Social Watcher follows. Only FREE ways to read them are used. type: 'rss' (any RSS feed, for example a Bluesky profile feed https://bsky.app/profile/<handle>/rss) or 'telegram' (a PUBLIC Telegram channel, read from its public web page https://t.me/s/<channel>). A post can only start a WATCH, never an alert on its own. X (Twitter) is not here because X no longer has a free way to read posts. Set 'on' to false to switch an account off.

accounts.name: Donald Trump (Truth Social)
accounts.via: trumpstruth.org - a free public archive of his Truth Social posts, run by Defending Democracy Together (not official, may be a few minutes late)
accounts.why: US president: posts about tariffs, the Fed, interest rates, the dollar and crypto

accounts.name: Binance announcements (Telegram)
accounts.via: Binance's public Telegram channel, read from https://t.me/s/binance_announcements
accounts.why: The largest crypto exchange: outages, paused withdrawals, security notices

accounts.name: Whale Alert (Telegram)
accounts.via: Whale Alert's public Telegram channel, read from https://t.me/s/whale_alert_io
accounts.why: Reports very large crypto transfers and hacks quickly. Many posts are routine transfers, so only hack-type posts count.
